text: Baseline numbers reported in chat 2026-11-22 and scored: standing broad jump 7 ft (84 in, 213 cm; 85% of benchmark), Echo bike 10 min 119 cal. Hevy has no calorie field (duration only for Air Bike) and stores distances in whole metres (broad jump, reach and jump-touch logged as 2.0/3.0 m), so calorie and jump scores come from chat via coach test score --result until the push/sync handles them. Standing reach and jump-and-touch heights for the dunk goal still need real numbers (inches).
